# Solar Dash third-party 3D assets

All models in this directory were created and distributed by Kenney and are
licensed under Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0). The original license notices
are preserved beside the models.

## City Kit (Industrial) 2.0

- Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-industrial
- License: CC0 1.0
- Imported models: `building-a.glb`, `solar-panel-landscape.glb`,
  `solar-panel-landscape-group.glb`
- Shared source texture: `Textures/colormap.png`

## Nature Kit 2.1

- Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit
- License: CC0 1.0
- Imported models: `rock_largeA.glb`, `rock_largeC.glb`, `log_large.glb`,
  `stump_old.glb`, `tree_pineSmallA.glb`, `plant_bushLarge.glb`

Only the selected low-poly GLB files are included so the browser build remains
small and no unused source-pack content is shipped.
